name: itsnotes
description: itsnotes — a personal notes app built with Node.js and PostgreSQL

scripts.install: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.test: cd server && npm test && cd ../client && npm test
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
scripts.android:build: cd client && npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:open: cd client && npx cap open android
